parts.t: Central Park in South Burnaby borders Vancouver and sits adjacent to one of the region's most popular urban parks. With direct SkyTrain access, a vibrant local scene, and a wide range of housing — from character homes to modern condos — it's one of Burnaby's most dynamic communities.
